decision.explanation: Two distinct films titled "Baby Doll" are referenced in the provided sources. Elia Kazan directed the 1956 film adaptation of Tennessee Williams' work, as stated in D1S1 and D3S3. Franco Giraldi directed the 1968 Italian film *La bambolona*, which was internationally released as *Baby Doll*, as stated in D4S1. These are separate films with the same title, and both directors are correctly attributed to their respective works.
